Description: Automate reminders and escalations for third-party vendor reviews so 95% of Critical/High reviews finish on time. See BRD.

Summary: Calculate review due dates from vendor tier
Description:
As a TPRM analyst, I want each vendor's next review date calculated from its risk tier, so that I don't track due dates by hand.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a vendor with risk tier "Medium" and last review completed 2025-06-30
When the vendor record is saved
Then the next review date is 2027-06-30

Traces to: FR-01

Summary: Send pre-due reminders to vendor owners
Description:
As a vendor owner, I want reminders 60, 30 and 7 days before my review is due and on the due date, so that I have time to complete it.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a Critical vendor with review due 2026-03-31 and status "Not started"
When the daily job runs on 2026-03-24
Then the owner receives the "7 days to due date" reminder

Traces to: FR-02, FR-03

Summary: Escalate 7-day overdue reviews to owner's manager
Description:
As the Head of TPRM, I want overdue reviews escalated to the owner's manager after 7 days, so that reviews don't stall.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a review due 2026-03-31 that is not complete
When the daily job runs on 2026-04-07
Then the owner's manager receives an escalation
And the escalation is logged

Traces to: FR-04

Summary: Escalate 30-day overdue Critical/High reviews to TPRM head
Description:
As the Head of TPRM, I want 30-day overdue Critical and High reviews escalated to me, so that I can act before an exam finding.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a High-tier review 30 days overdue
When the daily job runs
Then the Head of TPRM receives an escalation
And Medium and Low tiers are not escalated to the Head of TPRM

Traces to: FR-05

Summary: Stop reminders when review is complete
Description:
As a vendor owner, I want reminders to stop once my review is marked complete, so that I'm not sent irrelevant emails.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a review marked "Complete"
When the daily job runs
Then no reminder or escalation is sent for that vendor

Traces to: FR-06

Summary: Pause reminders with reason and end date
Description:
As a TPRM analyst, I want to pause reminders for a vendor with a reason and end date, so that vendors in offboarding aren't chased.

Acceptance criteria:
Given I pause reminders with reason "Contract ending" until 2026-05-01
When the daily job runs on 2026-04-15
Then no reminder is sent
And reminders resume on 2026-05-02 if the review is still open

Traces to: FR-07

As an internal auditor, I want a read-only log of every reminder and escalation, so that I can test the control without email searches.

Acceptance criteria:
Given any reminder or escalation is sent
Then the log records vendor ID, recipient, channel and timestamp
And no user, including administrators, can edit or delete the entry

Traces to: FR-08, NFR-02

As the Head of TPRM, I want a dashboard of upcoming, due and overdue reviews by tier and owner, so that I can report to the risk committee.

Acceptance criteria:
Given 1,000 vendors in the inventory
When I open the dashboard
Then it loads in under 3 seconds
And I can filter by tier and owner

Traces to: FR-09, NFR-04

As a TPRM analyst, I want to click from a dashboard tile to the vendor list behind it, so that I can follow up quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
Given the dashboard shows 12 overdue High-tier reviews
When I click the tile
Then I see the 12 vendors with owner and days overdue

Traces to: FR-09

Summary: Export log and dashboard data to CSV
Description:
As an internal auditor, I want to export the reminder log to CSV, so that I can select test samples.

Acceptance criteria:
Given I have the Auditor role
When I export the reminder log for Q1
Then I receive a CSV with every Q1 entry

Traces to: FR-10

As a vendor owner, I want to choose email or Microsoft Teams for reminders, so that I see them where I work.

Acceptance criteria:
Given my preference is "Teams"
When a reminder is due
Then I receive it in Teams and not by email

Traces to: FR-11

Summary: Weekly digest for owners of many vendors
Description:
As a vendor owner with more than 3 open reviews, I want one weekly digest, so that I'm not flooded with emails.

Acceptance criteria:
Given I own 5 vendors with open reviews
When reminders are due in the same week
Then I receive one digest listing all 5

Traces to: FR-12

Summary: Daily reminder job reliability and alerting
Description:
As the GRC platform lead, I want the daily job to finish by 07:00 ET and alert on failure, so that reminders are never silently missed.

Acceptance criteria:
Given the daily job fails
When 07:00 ET passes
Then the platform team receives an alert
And the job can be re-run without sending duplicates

Traces to: NFR-01

Summary: Role-based access for pause and date edits
Description:
As the Head of TPRM, I want only the TPRM role to pause reminders or change due dates, so that the control can't be bypassed.

Acceptance criteria:
Given I sign in through SSO without the TPRM role
When I try to pause reminders
Then the action is blocked and logged

Traces to: NFR-03
